correctness.rationale: Exact neighbour-sum identity uses degree n-3; odd case counts n independent-set states in each central layer and absorbs others within two updates. Even flanking layers are classified by triple-run maxima; the balanced layer is complement cyclic majority. Frozen adjacent pairs in cyclic majority exclude any recurrent points other than no-singletons or checkerboards, and the cyclic composition count gives H_m. Independent exhaustive graph-neighbour enumerations for n=5..18 checked every predicted F²-fixed state and fixed count; finite computation supports but is not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: This natural dense graph family has a structurally sharp parity contrast: odd complements admit only 2n+2 fixed attractor states and all initial states settle in at most two updates, while even complements admit exponentially many recurrent states and exact traveling half-turn two-cycles. The exact orbit census is not a pure renamed finite table: it derives odd-size tie physics, flanking density waves, and a balance-layer duality; the prior sequence is treated as a known ingredient. This is a complete recurrent-state classification for every n>=5, though not a basin census.
